title: caladenia cornuta
intro: Caladenia cornuta, commonly known as the Common Spotted Fan Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Caladenia cornuta include its ability to act as an antiseptic and antipyretic, making it useful in treating infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
